$comment: The paths that define the guardrails (`chock check --floor`, floor/control-plane-changed). Matched with fnmatch after case folding, so `*` crosses `/`. A pull request that adds, changes, deletes or re-modes one is listed; the base's `.chock/config.yaml` decides refuse or listed. Vendor hook files are agentseam's config_path for every repo-relative vendor (tests/test_floor_control_plane.py checks it) plus each local or override variant chock knows.
